note: Shared TS<->Python answer key for the decoded-prefix rule (brief 3-D). Producer side: python-backend/ruke_ml/video/scenes.py::measured_prefix_end. Consumer side: lib/server/attachindex/timeline.ts::measuredPrefixEnd. A duration is NOT a measurement of how far a decoder got: measured=false always yields 0.0. Booleans are rejected because bool is an int in Python. Cases are plain JSON; 1e400 parses to +Infinity on both sides.

contract_fields.cut_scan.scanned_seconds: measured decoded prefix, never the clip duration
contract_fields.cut_scan.prefix_measured: true only when ffmpeg's own -progress stream reported an out_time; absence must be read as unknown
contract_fields.cut_scan.truncated: the scan stopped at a bound, so later content is unknown
